title: Las cebollas: tres tamaños, capas que se caen y Zarpazos
description: docs/quests/nuria.md § Monsters. Each layer an onion loses flies off as curved pieces of skin, the one under it shows in another colour and it stands a step smaller, down to small and pale with none left. Cebollitas are small and easy, La Cebolla big, El Cebollón huge. Zarpazos (Papagato level 2) lands four little claws, a layer each.

steps.caption: Cebollitas: small, a layer or two. The easy ones, for Papagato to grow on
La Cebolla: bigger, eight layers, and every one of them adds to its blow
El Cebollón with its twelve layers: huge, twice the height of Gerard
A plain blow: one layer flies off in pieces, another colour shows under it and the onion stands a step smaller
At level 2 Papagato has learned Zarpazos
Zarpazos: Haru jumps on it and four little claws land one after another, a layer off with each, and it shrinks step by step
Four layers fewer: visibly smaller, and its blows lighter
With no layers left: small and pale. Now it can be finished, and now it burns
